Bound Stand feature, 1st level.

Each day, bind the stand to one object you hold or touch. When you Strike with a bound weapon, you can use the stand's attack modifier and damage. If the vessel is destroyed or taken from you, the stand unmanifests until you Manifest it into a new vessel. While the stand is manifested, the vessel can't be disarmed or taken from you against your will. The vessel has Hardness equal to half your level (minimum 1). Vessel Guard: reaction, once per round, when a Strike hits you, the vessel takes the blow and you reduce the damage by the vessel's Hardness.
